{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Brentaal Trade News''''' was a commercial and business [[NewsNet]] that was based on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]].<ref name="GNN 9">{{JournalCite|9|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] executive [[Dien Suub]] read the front page of it every morning.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan">{{DoD|The Gem of Alderaan}}</ref>

Although ''Brentaal Trade News'' was not officially part of [[Imperial HoloVision]], it nonetheless was required to publish any stories that paint the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in a positive light as well as spreading only loyal sentiment, with the threat of punishment if they fail to do so.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

On 37:2:23 [[Great ReSynchronization|GrS]], Brentaal Trade News reported on an [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] raid on a warehouse complex in [[Votrad]] that seized tons of raw materials set to be smuggled into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GNN 9" />
